title: Python as a translation, part I
objective: Own Python syntax, control flow and core data structures by translating what you already know from JavaScript. Start the DSA habit in Python.
theory: Dynamic typing, truthiness vs JS, mutability and copying (shallow vs deep), comprehension semantics.
practice: Daily translation exercises; NeetCode Arrays & Hashing in Python.
deliverables: 5 DSA problems solved in Python with complexity noted
checkpoint: Explain list vs dict vs set complexity
Write a dict comprehension without looking it up
Solve Two Sum in Python without syntax lookups

knowledge: List vs tuple vs set: pick one for three use cases
What is the complexity of `x in list` vs `x in set`?
practical: Write a dict comprehension inverting a dict
Solve Contains Duplicate + Valid Anagram cold
